meta.note: x = world X (east), y = world north/Z, meters. Level has no HM2 heightmap (legacy format); heights rebuilt from the lmap LandMesh triangle mesh (TIN). Verified against HM2 on 90 levels that carry both: median absolute error 0.14 m, worst 2.39 m. Row 0 of the heightmap is at originY.

airfields.note: runway centrelines in replay-world-meters; headingDeg is the ends[0]->ends[1] bearing, take-off runs takeoffHeadingDeg; altM is absolute altitude, not height above ground
